lines: | **`benchmark/2026-10-02-u14-bridge-baseline/`** | **U14 hardened-bridge baseline (offline): master bms/src (4d5cac38ff + fail-loud 9c14005a01) + persistent oh61-v7 window snapshot (westlake-inputs/sources/oh61-v7-b2133b5b-f6a498d1) + a reconstructed fn03 (846 = b6-r155 1f5986de + 4 kInactive hunks from dd57a00b, proven by .rodata reason codes) builds bridge v3 9a03b272, 50/50 TUs strict, same SHA on two fresh builds (Mac DevEco SDK). vs deployed 84695d62: 2490/2499 common functions same size (fn03 139/139), exports 2357->2356 (-5/+4), 0 consumer breaks; 92 diff items = a 29 / b 41 / c 1 / layout 21. b = three 846 features the window cohort lacks: R1 focus bridge (WindowCallbackBridge; v3 focus goes to a log-only Java method) and R2 root BLAST (port from real-work 0765bc53/0b816fe6 without its ScopedJniAttachment ctor), R3 process-published cross-namespace RSSurfaceNode (in no local tree -> rewrite; ran in 131/133 U10.1T8 runs; its 11 'no RSSurfaceNode' runs = exactly M1's population, so M1 must cover it too). a (display_manager framework copy OH-DISPLAY-EVENT, master APK-ORIENTATION) are inert with U13 jars (DisplayManagerProjectionProxy has no dispatchDisplayEvent(I)V; ManifestOrientationProjection absent): 0 keys move; with the peer, fd-minetest/fd-stk go landscape. u14-plan.md: land cohort -> v3+R1-R3 baseline, bridge-only full comparison -> M1 (2/3 hunks apply to the snapshot client) / M5 (SetSubWindowZLevel, check supportZLevel_) / M6 (site 846-identical in master) as separate patches.** |

- 2026-10-02 **无源部署件先按函数指纹复原,再判差异(U14 bridge 基线,cc-t3)**:部署 bridge 84695d62 无源,但 master bms/src + oh61-v7 窗口快照(westlake-inputs/sources/oh61-v7-b2133b5b-f6a498d1)+ 复原的 fn03 能在 Mac DevEco SDK 上严格链接出 v3 9a03b272(两次全新构建同 SHA),与 846 共有函数 2490/2499 同尺寸(`fnsize.py`,llvm-nm -S -C 逐函数比)。846 的 fn03 两个已知版本都不是:.rodata 有 dd57a00b 独有的 mapping-v2/UNSUPPORTED_OH_STAGE_STATE、b6-r155 独有的 OH_CLEAN_REPLAY、dd57 独有的 16 个 reason 码一个没有 → 复原为 1f5986de+4 个 kInactive hunk,139/139 函数同尺寸。规则:无源部署件先用版本特征串定位在哪两个已知版本之间、补最小增量、以逐函数尺寸全等为准收;别停在符号 diff。见 benchmark/2026-10-02-u14-bridge-baseline/。

- 2026-10-02 **846 bridge 独有、v3 缺的三件里两件在主路径上,不能当可选(cc-t3)**:R3 进程发布的跨副本 RSSurfaceNode(env WESTLAKE_RS_SURFACE_NODE_HOLDER_PTR_V1,本地无源→重写)在 U10.1T8 签认 133 跑里 131 跑走过(`getRSSurfaceNode: acquired process-published cross-namespace surface`;只有 termux/toutiao 没建窗);它的 11 跑 `no local or process-published RSSurfaceNode` 恰是 M1 人群——RS 节点持有槽与窗口指针同一单槽缺陷,M1 bridge 版必须两样都按会话分槽。R1 焦点桥:v3 把 OH 焦点送 SessionStageBridge.onUpdateFocus,Java 里只打日志,846 走 WindowCallbackBridge.onUpdateFocusStatus→dispatchWindowFocusChanged;R2 root BLAST 每次 createSession 都过。R1/R2 可从 real-work 0765bc53/0b816fe6 移植但**只搬函数体,ctor 保持平 GetEnv**(那份 ctor 用 ScopedJniAttachment=DIGEST 557 杀全部 app 的 WLTG 门控)。规则:判『丢掉某 846 独有功能』前,先用它自己的日志行数一遍有多少 key 跑过(`usage_b.py`)。

- 2026-10-02 **按名找 Java peer 的 native 新路径,peer 类和确切方法签名都在才生效(cc-t3)**:master display_manager_adapter_jni.cpp 的 OH-DISPLAY-EVENT 要 `adapter.activity.DisplayManagerProjectionProxy.dispatchDisplayEvent(I)V`,U13 runtime 0482c9b1 有这个类但**没有这个方法**(dexdump),于是每进程一次 NoSuchMethodError 清掉、在 RegisterDisplayListener 之前返回=惰性;APK-ORIENTATION 要的 ManifestOrientationProjection 两个 jar 都没有。规则:预测 native 新路径影响前用 dexdump 核方法签名,不只看类名。
